ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark central region. High-intensity mottling is concentrated along the distal margins. On the right lobe (viewer perspective), a large high-contrast white patch occupies the outer third of the trailing edge. On the left lobe, high-intensity pixels are limited to the extreme outer tip and leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree angle and a depth roughly 1/8th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge. Distinct jagged peaks are most pronounced near the lateral tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve tapering towards narrow, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular white pixel clusters (3-5 pixels in diameter) are visible within the dark pigment of the left lobe's central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The left lateral tip exhibits an irregular, eroded profile compared to the more pointed right lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity 'splash' pattern on the right lobe's upper trailing edge that does not cross into the central fluke region.
